entries.zh: 忍屈受苦；屈身承当劳苦
entries.en: to suffer toils; to endure humiliation and hardship

entries.zh: 气量高广，能大量容受；宽宏大量
entries.en: lofty magnanimity; to forbear much, very long-suffering
entries.notes: 西语尾"mui supido"难解（疑为"mui sufrido／极能忍耐"之讹写），释义以汉栏"高量"与"Sufrior mucho"（大量容受）为据

entries.zh: 宽舒安泰；安然从容地容受
entries.en: calm and at ease; composed, patient endurance

entries.zh: 心胸宽宏；有气量，能容能忍
entries.en: magnanimous; to forbear much with spirit

entries.zh: 度量宽大；容让有量
entries.en: tolerant and forbearing; to bear much with courage

entries.zh: 大度量；气量极大，能大容大忍
entries.en: great magnanimity; ample measure of endurance

entries.zh: 忍口；忍住不说，闭口不言
entries.en: to hold one's tongue; to endure without speaking
entries.notes: 汉字首字有[疑]（思/忍），依闽南音 lun 与西语"no hablar（不言）"取"忍口"义

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语栏含删除线难辨字且句尾残断（[残]，"...a los maiores para ca–"），汉字首字亦有[疑]（縱/從），四栏无法互证，语义无从定夺

entries.zh: 忍气；忍住怒气，受辱不发作
entries.en: to swallow one's anger; to endure insults with tolerance
entries.notes: 首字[疑]（思/忍），依闽南音 xim 与西语"含忍受辱"（injurias con tolerancia）取"忍气"义

entries.zh: 海量；度量如海，大量容受而不动怒
entries.en: sea-like boundless magnanimity; to endure without getting angry

entries.zh: 海含（即"海涵"）；如海包涵，宽宏容人
entries.en: ocean-like magnanimous forgiveness; to bear with others generously

entries.zh: 海纳；如海纳百川，兼收并容
entries.en: to receive all as the sea does; all-embracing tolerance

entries.zh: 含容；包容涵容，不加计较
entries.en: to contain and tolerate; forbearance

entries.zh: 饶裕；饶恕宽容，不咎于人
entries.en: to forgive and spare; generous forbearance

entries.zh: 忍让；退让不争，不图报复
entries.en: to forbear and yield; to suffer without seeking revenge
entries.notes: 首字[疑]（思/忍），依闽南音 nio（让）与西语"不加报复"（sin tomar venganza）取"忍让"义

entries.zh: 会容忍得；能够容忍并肯饶恕
entries.en: able to endure and forgive
entries.notes: "忍"字[疑]（思/忍）；"會…得"为能性结构，义为"能够容忍"，对应西语 sufrior y perdonar

entries.zh: 担艰苦；担受艰苦，吃苦受累
entries.en: to bear hardship; to suffer and undergo

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语栏残损不成句（[残]，"unelpobreg noda hablan–"难辨读），汉栏"鬱志(ut chy)"虽可读（郁结于志）但无法与西语互证

entries.zh: 砥柱；如中流砥柱，久历劳苦而屹立不移
entries.en: mainstay and pillar; steadfastly enduring constant toils
entries.notes: 西语栏中段残损难辨（[残]），依可读之"Sufrior constante…trabaxos"与汉栏"砥柱"取坚忍不移义

entries.zh: 会忍得；忍得住，受得了
entries.en: able to bear it; can endure
entries.notes: 首字[疑]（思/忍），依闽南音 xim 取"忍"义，对应西语"se puede sufrir"（能够忍受）

entries.zh: 吞忍；忍气吞声，把委屈咽下独自承受
entries.en: to swallow one's resentment and endure in silence
entries.notes: "忍"字[疑]（思/忍）；闽南 thun-lun"吞忍"义为忍气吞声

entries.zh: 相忍；彼此忍让，互相容受
entries.en: to bear with one another; mutual forbearance
entries.notes: "忍"字[疑]（思/忍），依西语"sufrirse unos a otros"（彼此容忍）取"相忍"义
